_note: Layer-local records where the four bridges differ by pre-existing design, recorded here, not unified. argv array cap exists only where argv arrays are kept (py/node); the browser drops argv wholesale and java carries seed argv under a budget, not a count. Timeout integer domain agrees (1..3600); only the message floor differs. Dispatch groups agree on wait/capture/mutation; only resume membership (browser reload) and java's conflated outstanding flag differ.

timeoutMessages.py: timeout must be between 0 and 3600 seconds
timeoutMessages.node: timeout must be between 0 and 3600 seconds
timeoutMessages.browser: timeout must be between 0 and 3600 seconds
timeoutMessages.java: timeout must be between 1 and 3600 seconds
